versions.changelog:
## Calmer Fish 1.0

First release.

- Every non-legendary fish you catch with a rod is calmer in the fishing minigame: 51 fish, from anchovy to blobfish.
- Choose the level in the config: Light (difficulty -15 %), Medium (-30 %, default) or Strong (-45 %). No fish gets easier than a carp.
- Behaviour, seasons, times, weather, locations and sizes stay as they are. Legendary fish are unchanged.

## Calmer Fish 1.1

Legendary fish, if you want.

- New config option `Legendaries` (off by default): turn it on and the five legendary fish and their Legendary Fish II versions fight 15 % less, whatever level you picked. Legend drops from 110 to 94, Glacierfish from 100 to 85.
- With the option off, nothing changes: legendary fish keep their full challenge, all other fish work as in 1.0.
- Behaviour, seasons and locations of the legendary fish stay as they are.

## Calmer Fish 1.2

The settings are now in German too.

- Both config settings, the level and the switch for legendary fish, now have readable names, descriptions and value labels in the in-game config menu, in English and German. Players with the game set to German see them in German; everyone else keeps English.
- Same fish, same levels, same defaults, nothing else changes. Your settings carry over.
